name: b2b-icp-and-customer-insight
description: Review the ICP you already have against today's customers, deals and figures, with metric gaps computed by script and every proposed change a hypothesis with its test; plan customer interviews that test your own hypotheses and synthesise many interviews with each item counted once per interview; build a lead or account fit scoring model with labelled example weights you can change; set buying role hypotheses with validation questions; and check product market fit metrics against your own targets.
